benchmark: Codex AIR DeepSWE v1.1 full A/B

source.runner: datacurve-pier > 0.3.0 with a separate verifier environment

frontier_difficulty_evidence.claim: Published full-benchmark scores are materially below 100%; this does not guarantee that future models cannot improve.

scope.pilot_only: The official deterministic --n-tasks 10 --sample-seed 0 subset may validate infrastructure but cannot replace the primary comparison.
scope.arm_order: Counterbalance per task from SHA256('codex-air-deepswe-v11:' + task_id).

arms.direct: gpt-5.6-sol / xhigh / default with the official agent-visible task prompt and no AIR invocation
arms.air: one gpt-5.6-sol / xhigh / default semantic controller explicitly invoking $codex-air; one gpt-5.6-luna / max worker with Fast requested by default; two or three Luna workers only after the quantitative parallel gate
arms.review: the same Sol controller reviews the final candidate; Luna cannot approve overall completion; no routine challenger
arms.run_cap: Use the task's pinned resource limits; record any harness-level cap identically for both arms

scoring.secondary_quality: Mean verifier pass fraction from reward.json across all 113 tasks
scoring.invalid_task: Collection failure, empty verifier output, timeout, invalid candidate, or isolation violation scores 0 unless a shared pre-inference infrastructure failure invalidates both paired cells.
scoring.quality_gate: AIR resolved rate must be greater than or equal to Direct resolved rate before latency or cost can be called a win.
scoring.latency: Report total wall time, median paired task ratio, and 95th-percentile task wall time; for AIR also report controller, batch, slowest-leaf, persistence, and aggregate-review spans.
scoring.usage: Input, cached-input, output, and reasoning tokens by model, role, task, and actual service tier when exposed.
scoring.cost: Reprice every token type at its recorded model and actual tier; never multiply aggregate tokens by a blended price.
scoring.air_target: Quality gate passes, wall time is not worse, and API-equivalent AIR / Direct cost is at or below 0.55.

isolation.forbidden: Agent access to tests/, solution/, benchmark source outside the prepared task, prior trajectories, leaderboard task outcomes, sibling workspaces, or the other arm.
isolation.grading: Collect the candidate patch after inference and apply it in Pier's pristine separate verifier container.
isolation.artifacts: Retain exact task IDs, source SHA, runtime versions, launch identities, actual tiers, task-level rewards, patches, verifier outputs, wall times, and token telemetry.
